test[3]=[0,0,0,0,0,0,5,5,0,5,5,5,5,5,5]

test[13][3]=6; test[14][3]=6; test[14][8]=8
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # The isolated vertical marks below the horizontal bands identify the broken columns.
    guides = [c for c in range(w) if any(out[r][c] for r in range(h) if r >= h - 4)]
    bands = {}
    for c in guides:
        for r in range(h):
            if out[r][c] == 0 and c > 0 and c + 1 < w and out[r][c-1] != 0 and out[r][c-1] == out[r][c+1]:
                bands.setdefault(c, []).append((r, out[r][c-1]))
    for c, rows in bands.items():
        rows.sort()
        start = 0
        for r, color in rows:
            for y in range(start, r + 1):
                out[y][c] = color
            start = r + 1
    return out
'''
